description: This file contains Sass mixins for button styling variants and sizes, such as button-variant, button-outline-variant, and button-size, aimed at generating button CSS styles with different states and sizes.

methods.name: button-variant
methods.description: Defines styles for different button variants, including hover, focus, active, and disabled states.

methods.name: button-outline-variant
methods.description: Defines styles for outline button variants with hover, focus, active, and disabled states.

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Sets padding, font size, line height, and border-radius for different button sizes.
